title: The Bared-Fang Wolf Has No Master

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To begin Sirius Symboli's training,
I check over the menu I've prepared.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Who won yesterday's contest?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Setting my prepared menu aside,
I look at the one Sirius Symboli created underneath it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Correct.
Guess your memory isn't totally hopeless after all, pup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some time has passed since I became Sirius Symboli's Trainer,
and our showdowns over "choices" continue just as before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And today's training is the result of my loss.
The menu Sirius Symboli prepared is well thought out, but—

text_block_list.name: Colleague Trainer
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... I honestly don't know how you manage to stay her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Colleague Trainer
text_block_list.text:
She's intimidating, always bosses you around,
and doesn't treat you like a Trainer at all, does she?

text_block_list.name: Colleague Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Out of pure curiosity...
why do you go to such lengths to stick with her?

text_block_list.name: Colleague Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Her talent is undeniable, sure. But... is that really enough
to keep up? Especially when you're supposed to be guiding her...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—That's a fair point. Looking back,
Sirius Symboli's attitude has been unwavering since the day we met.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If you want me to obey, beat me."
...A simple rule, yet an immensely difficult hurdle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At first, I was captivated by her running. I wanted to see
that strength up close, and in the end, I made the "choice" myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet, even with an attitude so reckless from an outsider's view—
why am I so drawn to a back that never turns to look?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The reason is—

text_block_list.name: Pierced Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Let me hear you, everyone! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Entourage
text_block_list.text: Great work today, Sirius-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Move. Don't block my way.

text_block_list.name: Pierced Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Sorry 'bout that! Your running is just so crazy good!
We won't get in your way, so can we watch up close?!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Up close? Then run.
Though with those fawn legs, who knows if you can keep up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Even when treated to such words and sharp attitude,
the Umamusume around her seemed thrilled rather than offended.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Why is that...? Normally, being spoken to like that would drive
people away. And surely, I shouldn't be an exception...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet, why do I struggle so desperately to keep up?
Why do I keep challenging her and making "choices" no matter how often I lose—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Tummy rumbling, pup?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli ruffles my hair from behind.
As I stumble in surprise, I hear her chuckle softly.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Missing your master already?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hmph? Scheming something, then? Forget it.
A puppy's tricks only work once.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...She's likely referring to our previous game of nine-ball.
Sirius Symboli flashes a provocative, fearless grin.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even when faced with that smirk, I have no desire to step down as her Trainer.
Though I haven't quite figured out the reason myself yet—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that as I continue to learn more and more about
the Umamusume known as Sirius Symboli, I'll be able to put it into words.
